Trigger.TriggerText:
/** Check if any Confirmation Tests exists*/

declare
 nCount number;
 v_count number:=0;
begin
 select count(*)
 into nCount
 from unit_test_results
 where --MS chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 unit_id = :donations.unit_id 
 and coll_date = :donations.coll_date 
 and exists (
 select test_id 
 from valid_tests_don
 where test_id = unit_test_results.test_id);
 if nCount > 0 then
 set_item_property( 'donors.pb_show_cnfrm', enabled, property_true );
 else
 set_item_property( 'donors.pb_show_cnfrm', enabled, property_false );
 end if;
exception
 when others then
 null;
end;

declare
 v_count number:=0;
begin

 select count(*) into v_count 
 from unit_test_results utr, valid_tests_don vt
 where --MS chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 unit_id = :donations.unit_id 
 and coll_date = :donations.coll_date 
 and utr.test_id = vt.test_id
 and vt.view_level > :acc_level and
 utr.test_id in ('ABORH','ALT','CHOL','CMV','HBC','HBSAG','HCV','HIV-1/2','HIV1AG','HTLV-I/II','IAT','STS') 
 and sysdate between vt.eff_date and nvl(vt.term_date,sysdate);
 if v_count > 0 then
 :donors.s_view:='NOTE:Additional test results associated with this unit are not within your view level ..';
else
 :donors.s_view:=null;
end if;

ENd;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DONOR_DONATIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_donor_donations
 ( p_donor_id in varchar2,
 p_donations out number,
 p_last_donation_date out varchar2,
 p_last_donation_id out varchar2) IS

 cursor cur_donations is
 select count(unit_id)
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id;
 --MS and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id;

 cursor cur_last_donation is
 select unit_id, to_char(coll_date, 'MM-DD-YY')
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id
 --MS and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and coll_date = (select max(coll_date)
 from donations
 where donor_id = p_donor_id);
 --MS and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id);

BEGIN
 if p_donor_id is not null then
 /*
 ** get total donations
 */
 open cur_donations;
 fetch cur_donations
 into p_donations;
 if cur_donations%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_donations;
 end if;
 if cur_donations%isopen then
 close cur_donations;
 end if;

 /*
 ** get last donation details
 */
 open cur_last_donation;
 fetch cur_last_donation
 into p_last_donation_id, p_last_donation_date;
 if cur_last_donation%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_last_donation;
 end if;
 if cur_last_donation%isopen then
 close cur_last_donation;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DONOR_NAME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_donor_name 
 (p_donor_id in varchar2) IS

 szFirstName varchar2(50) := '';
 szMiddleName varchar2(50) := '';
 szLastName varchar2(50) := '';
 szLastNameSuffix varchar2(50) := '';
 szGender varchar2(6) := '';
 -- nSSN number := 0 ;
 szABODESC varchar2(50) := '';
 szDOB date ;
 szSSNMode number;
 nSSN1 varchar2(30);

 cursor cur_donor is
 select a.first_name,
 a.middle_name,
 a.last_name,
 nvl(a.last_name_suffix, ''),
 decode(a.gender, 'M', 'Male', 'F', 'Female', ''), 
 a.date_of_birth,
 b.description
 from donors a, valid_master_codes b
 where a.donor_id = p_donor_id
 and b.code_type = 'ABO'
 and b.code = nvl(a.blood_type, 'NONE');
 --and a.chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id;

BEGIN


 if p_donor_id is not null then
 open cur_donor;
 fetch cur_donor
 into szFirstName,
 szMiddleName,
 szLastName,
 szLastNameSuffix,
 szGender,
 szDOB,
 szABODESC;
 if cur_donor%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_donor;
 else
 :donors.donor_id := p_donor_id;
 
 
 :donors.name := initcap(szLastName) || ', ' || 
 initcap(szFirstName) || ' ' || 
 initcap(szMiddleName);
 :donors.gender := initcap(szGender);
 :donors.date_of_birth := szDOB;
 :donors.blood_type := substr(szABODESC, 1, 6);
 end if;
 if cur_donor%isopen then
 close cur_donor;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_DONORS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this procedure will do the actual work.
*/
PROCEDURE populate_donors IS
 szDonorID varchar2(10) := '';
 nTotalDonations number;

 cursor cur_donations is
 select count(*)
 from donations
 where donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 --MS and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id
 and unit_id is not null;

BEGIN
 
 open cur_donations;
 fetch cur_donations
 into nTotalDonations;
 if cur_donations%notfound then
 nTotalDonations := 0;
 end if;
 if cur_donations% isopen then
 close cur_donations;
 end if;
 if nTotalDonations < 1 then
 show_error('18024');
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 
 szDonorID := :parameter.p_DONOR_ID;
 :donors.donor_id := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 get_donor_name(szDonorid);
 set_block_property('donations',
 default_where,
 ' donor_id = ' || in_quotes(:parameter.p_donor_id)||
 ' and unit_id is not null'); -- Added by Lakshmi on 3/16/98
 go_block('donations');
 execute_query;
 go_item('donations.dummy_unit_id');
 compute_total_credits;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPUTE_TOTAL_CREDITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE compute_total_credits IS
 nTotalCredits number := 0;
 cursor cur_credit is
 select sum(credit_count)
 from donations
 where donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id;
 --and chapter_id = :parameter.p_chapter_id;
BEGIN
 open cur_credit;
 fetch cur_credit
 into nTotalCredits;
 if cur_credit%notfound then
 ntotalCredits := 0;
 end if;
 if cur_credit%isopen then
 close cur_credit;
 end if;

 if nTotalCredits = 0 then
 set_window_property('win_donation', title, 'Donation History for [' || :parameter.p_donor_id || ']' || ' Total Donation Credits - ' || to_char(nTotalCredits));
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: IS_REACTIVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION is_reactive (p_code varchar2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 bResult BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 szTmp varchar2(5);
BEGIN

 select code
 into szTmp
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'REAC'
 and code = p_code and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;

 RETURN TRUE;

 exception
 when no_data_found then
 RETURN FALSE;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_RESULTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_results IS
 szTestId varchar2(10);
 szResult varchar2(10);
 szChkDgt varchar2(3);
 szAbsorbance varchar2(20);
 bReactiveResult Boolean := FALSE;
 szABO varchar2(20);
 nCount number:=0;
 nCount1 number:=0;
 
 SzUnitId varchar2(20);
 SzDonUnitid varchar2(20);
 
 cursor cur_abo (p_blood_type varchar2) is
 select description
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'ABO'
 and code = nvl(p_blood_type, 'NONE');

 /*CURSOR cur_tests is select test_id,decode(edit_test_results_flag,'Y','P','O') test_type from valid_tests 
 where edit_result_flag ='Y' 
 and view_level < :acc_level
 and ((sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)) OR
 (term_date is not null and test_id in (select test_id from 
 unit_test_results where unit_id=:donors.unit_id and coll_date=:donors.coll_date)))
 order by decode(test_results_flag,'Y','P',1,'O',2);
 */
 
 CURSOR cur_tests(pa_unit_id varchar2) is select test_id from valid_tests_don 
 where edit_result_flag ='Y' 
 and view_level < :acc_level
 and (:donors.coll_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:donors.coll_date+1)) 
 and test_id in (select test_id from unit_test_results where unit_id=pa_unit_id)
 order by test_id;
 
 CURSOR cur_antg(pa_unit_id varchar2) is select utrs.test_id , utrs.rowid from unit_test_results UTRS, valid_tests_don V
 where test_group in ('AG','ROUAG','RHBAT','MAG') 
 and view_level < :acc_level
 and (:donors.coll_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:donors.coll_date+1)) 
 and utrs.test_id =V.test_id and utrs.unit_id=pa_unit_id
 order by utrs.test_id;

 
 CURSOR cur_tests1(pa_unit_id varchar2) is select test_id from unit_test_results where unit_id=pa_unit_id and 
 coll_date=:donors.coll_date and test_id not in
 ( select test_id from valid_tests_don where test_group in ('CNFRM','SUPP') and
 :donors.coll_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:donors.coll_date+1)
 UNION
 select test_id from valid_tests_don where edit_result_flag ='Y' and
 view_level < :acc_level and :donors.coll_date between eff_date and 
 nvl(term_date,:donors.coll_date+1) 
 and test_id in (select test_id from unit_test_results 
 where unit_id=pa_unit_id)
 UNION
 select test_id from valid_tests_don where test_group in ('AG','ROUAG','RHBAT','MAG')
 and view_level < :acc_level
 and (:donors.coll_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:donors.coll_date+1)) 
 and test_id in (select test_id from unit_test_results 
 where unit_id=pa_unit_id) 
 )
 and test_id in (select test_id from valid_tests_don where view_level<:acc_level) -- IM: 9600
 
 order by test_id ;
 
 
BEGIN
 /*diptiia -- added to remove chk digit for ISBT units*/
 
 --message('Acc level='||:acc_level); pause;
 
 if length(:donors.unit_id) = 15 then --ISBT
 SzUnitId := substr(:donors.unit_id, 1, 13);
 else
 SzUnitId := :donors.unit_id;
 end if;
 
 if length(:donations.unit_id) = 15 then --ISBT
 SzDonUnitId := substr(:donations.unit_id, 1, 13);
 else
 SzDonUnitId := :donations.unit_id;
 end if;
 
 GO_BLOCK('TEST_RESULTS');
 FOR Z in cur_tests(SzUnitId) loop
 
 -- message(z.test_id);pause;
 :test_results.test_id:=Z.test_id;
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount from valid_tests_don where test_id=Z.test_id and 
 :donors.coll_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:donors.coll_date+1);
 If nCount = 0 then
 :test_results.test_type:='Other'; 
 Else 
 select nvl(count(*),0) into nCount1 from valid_tests_don where test_id=Z.test_id and 
 :donors.coll_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:donors.coll_date+1) and edit_result_flag='Y';
 If nCount1 > 0 then 
 :test_results.test_type:='Profile';
 Else
 :test_results.test_type:='Other';
 End if; 
 End If; 
 Begin 
 
 select result_code, ltrim( absorbance) into 
 szResult,szAbsorbance from unit_test_results where
 unit_id=SzDonUnitId and coll_date=:donations.coll_date and test_id=Z.test_id; 
 
--message('1 '||szResult);pause;

 IF :test_results.test_id in ('ABO','ABORH') then
 open cur_abo(szResult);
 fetch cur_abo into szABO;
 if cur_abo%isopen then
 close cur_abo;
 end if; 
 :test_results.result_code:=initcap(szABO);
 
 ELSE 
 :test_results.result_code:=szResult;
 :test_results.absorbance:=szAbsorbance;
 bReactiveResult := FALSE;
 bReactiveResult := is_reactive(szResult);
 If bReactiveResult then
 :test_results.reactive:='Yes'; 
 End If;
 END IF;

 and test_id in (select test_id from unit_test_results where unit_id=pa_unit_id)

 and view_level < :acc_level

 coll_date=:donors.coll_date and test_id not in

 select test_id from valid_tests_don where view_level < :acc_level and test_group in ('CNFRM','SUPP')
